concept: web form drop down menu form
author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a wide dropdown field (two thirds of the width) laid over the top-left of an option panel, with a bold check in the panel marking the selected option. Candidate with two option lines instead of the check was rendered and compared; the check carries 'selected option' better. Rounded r3 corners were dropped because exact 8-unit gaps to a contour with arcs came back review; round joins still paint the corners round.
omissions: The reference's two option lines: the panel interior below the field is one 8-unit band tall and holds the check or one row, not both.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'square-check' / 'clipboard-check': box with an open check; no dropdown-with-panel match.
